subclassFeature.name: Oath of the Blood
entries: While most paladins pledge their swords to righteous deities, honor, or sworn protection, paladins of the Oath of the Blood are guided by raw, primal vitality and martial dominance. Born from ancient, perilous hemomancy, only those with iron discipline can command this blood-fueled power without being consumed by it, transforming themselves into indomitable warriors.

subclassFeature.name: Tenets of the Blood
entries: {@i (3rd-level Oath of the Blood feature)}
The tenets of blood are held with unyielding resolve, as giving in to frenzy leads to mindless destruction:

entries.name: Bleed and Triumph
entries: No matter how much blood you must shed, you must never lose command of your mind. Channel your vital essence to lead your comrades to victory.

entries.name: No Negotiations with Corruption
entries: Dark entities will seek to exploit your blood-bought power. Give them neither quarter nor compromise; destroy them without hesitation.

entries.name: Remember Your Humanity
entries: You are not a monstrous predator of the night; you are a champion of the mortal realm, and your strength exists to protect it.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: {@i (3rd-level Oath of the Blood feature)}
You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity
entries: {@i (3rd-level Oath of the Blood feature)}
When you take this oath at 3rd level, you gain the following two Channel Divinity options:

entries.name: Draining Strike
entries: Immediately after you deal damage to a creature with your {@classFeature Divine Smite|Paladin|PHB|2} feature, you can use your Channel Divinity as a {@action bonus action} to distribute vitality to creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you (including yourself). The total number of hit points you distribute equals half the damage dealt by the smite attack (rounded down).

entries.name: Bloody Weapon
entries: As a {@action bonus action}, you coat your weapon in empowered vital essence, sacrificing {@damage 1d8} hit points to enhance its edge. For 1 minute, the weapon deals extra damage equal to the sacrificed roll. Additionally, the first target hit takes {@damage 1d4} piercing damage at the start of each of its turns from lingering bleeding, until a creature uses an action to tend the wound with a {@skill Medicine} check against your spell save DC {@dc 8+pb+cha} and a basic bandage. Your weapon counts as magical for the duration.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Blood
entries: {@i (7th-level Oath of the Blood feature)}

Starting at 7th level, you can radiate an overwhelming wave of crimson dread. As an {@action action}, each hostile creature within 10 feet of you must make an {@savingThrow Intelligence} saving throw against your spell save DC {@dc 8+pb+cha}. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d12} psychic damage. You gain temporary hit points equal to half the total damage dealt. Once you use this action, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Absorb Life
entries: {@i (15th-level Oath of the Blood feature)}

Starting at 15th level, whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee weapon attack or melee spell attack, you can use your {@action reaction} to gain temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level. These temporary hit points last until you finish a long rest. While you have these temporary hit points, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) and regain all expended uses after finishing a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Ichor
entries: {@i (20th-level Oath of the Blood feature)}

At 20th level, you can unleash a terrifying avatar of sanguinary power. As an {@action action}, you expend {@damage 2d12} hit points to project a circle of flowing vital energy in a 30-foot radius centered on you for 1 minute, gaining the following benefits:

items: Hostile creatures treat the area within 30 feet of you as difficult terrain, regardless of flying, swimming, or hovering.
Wings of solid crimson manifest from your back, granting you a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

When a creature within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your {@action reaction} to cause another creature within 30 feet to take the same amount of necrotic, psychic, or radiant damage (your choice).
Your melee attacks deal an extra {@damage 2d12} necrotic, psychic, or radiant damage (your choice).

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
